title: Lesson 60 - We Need Another Way Home

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: We need another way home. The board gives us a coach connection, a ferry-and-bus route, or the 9:10 direct train.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Let’s state our priorities first. Our top priority is arriving before nine, and we can spend no more than twenty-five dollars extra.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I’d also prefer no more than one transfer. The ferry route has one transfer and arrives at 8:40.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: But the status line says the 6:10 ferry is canceled because of high winds. That rules out the ferry route.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Our current tickets are valid on the 9:10 direct train at no extra charge, but it doesn’t arrive until 10:25.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: So it fails our arrival-time priority. It can be the backup if the earlier connection stops working.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: The best available option is the 5:40 coach to Lake Junction, followed by the 6:35 regional train.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It reaches Riverton at 8:05 and costs twelve dollars extra. That fits all three limits.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: We need to allow time for the transfer slip. The note says to collect it from Bay 3 before boarding.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: And boarding closes at 5:35, so our decision deadline is earlier than the 5:40 departure time.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That’s not how I remembered the first notice. I thought the coach left from Bay 5.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: The record now shows Bay 7. You may be mixing up the coach bay with the slip counter at Bay 3.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: You’re right. Looking back, I combined two numbers from the same announcement.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Is it usually enough to collect one transfer slip for both of us, or do we each need one?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: It depends on the ticket, so let’s not assume. We need to confirm the connection at the service desk.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I’ll ask whether the coach is still on time, whether we need two slips, and whether twelve dollars is the total supplement.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I’ll confirm Bay 7 and the 5:35 boarding cutoff. If we’d kept relying on the first number we remembered, we would’ve waited at the wrong bay.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: The desk confirms two slips, twelve dollars total, Bay 7, and a 5:35 cutoff. The regional train is still due at 6:35.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Then the coach connection is our main plan, and the 9:10 direct train is our backup.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Agreed. Let’s collect the slips now and be at Bay 7 by 5:28 rather than using every minute of the margin.

transfer.title: 车站广播（陌生美式男声）
transfer.instruction: 先听两遍，记录取消原因、仍有效的车票、凭条领取点、乘车站台、停止登车时间和备用直达列车。
